thread:
marta: Quick thread for the upcoming docs release. We need a short relnotes blurb, migration checklist for Private customers, and fixes for a couple of SDK examples that regressed. Trying to keep this tight.

kevin: I can update JS/TS snippets. Which ones regressed?

marta: Two streaming examples in /docs/sdk/js and the quickstart that uses the old auth header. Also the example that shows `client.stream()` needs a polling alternative.

jia: I'll take Go auth and the Python embedding sample. For the Python embed, should we add an opt-out param example for customers who need legacy behavior?

marta: Yes, include the opt-out but mark it deprecated with a one-line note and a link to the migration page.

sam: I'll write the migration checklist for Private: steps, verification commands, rollback hint. Plan: 1) backup model pins; 2) deploy canary to 1/5 nodes; 3) run synthetic traffic check; 4) verify KV cache warmup. Add exact commands.

lauren: Product wants a single-line billing callout for Dedicated autoscale: "Autoscale pools now support configured burst buckets; bursts will consume burst credits billed at a separate burst rate." Finance will confirm wording.

oliver: Infra note for Known issues: small cohort of Dedicated pools saw p95 latency spike during warm-start on 2026-03-22 03:00-04:00 UTC. Status: investigating. Add conservative language.

kevin: For the JS polling example I'll show how to poll the batch endpoint with exponential backoff. Small snippet: `while (!done) { await sleep(backoff); const r = await client.fetchBatch(id); }` and state expected fields (model, status, request_id).

marta: Good. Add a one-line "how to test" under each snippet: install, set REDWOOD_API_KEY, run the example, check model+request_id. Keep it two bullets.

release-bot: Draft relnotes created at /docs/releases/2026-03-25-relnotes-minor. PR: 4901.

jia: ETA: I'll open a PR for Go/Python tomorrow AM.

sam: I'll push the Private migration scaffold today; it'll include commands like `rictl deploy --canary --nodes 1` and a smoke test script.

kevin: I'll aim to have JS PR by EOD PST. I'll also run the anchor-checker and include fixes for broken links.

lauren: Reminder: localization only for core blurb (EU/JP). We'll decide after PR copy finalization.

marta: Owners summary: JS/TS -> kevin; Go/Python -> jia; migration guide -> sam; release blurb + finance -> lauren/oliver. Please add :eyes: on PRs when ready.

kevin: Noted.

release-bot: Reminder scheduled: relnotes final review in 8 hours.

marta: Thanks all, will drop the draft link here once I assemble it.
